trophies.description: Unlock every other trophy. You are a Leonida Legend.
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn. Finish every other trophy first — the 100% completion Gold, A Long Road, is the long pole at roughly 200 hours — and the Platinum pops on its own. It has no task of its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the story first: the in-game 100% Completion Checklist only unlocks after the credits (Touch Pad, then Progress). It is lenient — most categories ask for a share, not everything — but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need full completion. Expect around 100 hours of cleanup after the 60 to 80 hour story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. You need 250 of any mix. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to grind. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. The 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge (42).
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn, and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. These are also required in full for 100% completion, so there is no shortcut — practise each range's weapon set until the gold threshold feels comfortable.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away.
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults feed the robbery systems behind the 100% checklist too — that checklist wants all eight vaults — so keep robbing past five and you will clear both.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight Strangers and Freaks mission strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a final-mission trophy of their own, so their strands pull double duty. Strand markers appear on the map as you explore; check Progress to see which strands are still open.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete any three collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist wants 15, so collecting steadily as you travel pays off twice — three sets is the trophy, fifteen is the checklist.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.description: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app. Scan unfamiliar vehicles and landmarks as you go — the app is also how you track vehicles for Whip It Good — and the count builds up naturally across the story if you scan often.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once (9 in total).
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once — races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, golf, pool and the rest. One attempt each is enough; you do not need to win or finish well. Open the map's Activities tab to see which types you have not tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations — 42 drone time trials in total. These are required in full for 100% completion too, so the trophy and the checklist clear together. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and only wins in distinct races count — repeating the same race does not. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing also builds your Focus, which helps the shooting ranges, so a few rounds here are time well spent.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to the end. Any arcade machine in Leonida counts — pick the game you find easiest and finish one full run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots. THIS IS THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: one spot sits at Jason's house and is only available in Chapter 1, so meditate there before the chapter ends. The other 17 spots stay available — sweep them during cleanup and check your count in Progress.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. You can skip the hardest 30 — the 100% checklist wants 70, so the trophy at 50 is a milestone on the way, not a separate grind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4-star Wanted level with your partner.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star Wanted level and then lose it. Use the open roads outside the city to break line of sight, and keep your partner close until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your Wanted level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back to back without letting your Wanted level drop. Plan a route through three nearby shops and move fast between them — if the stars clear, the chain resets.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you encounter them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning long past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming mode. Pick a busy fight, build Focus first — shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing all raise it — then trigger Focus when several enemies are grouped.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt does not count.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away clean. Ambush the truck on a quiet stretch of road, grab the cash and break away before the response arrives.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida — the whole state map, not just Vice City. Drive the highways, visit the smaller towns and the wilderness; the trophy pops once every region has been visited.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations cleared, so this trophy falls out naturally on the way to 100%.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — keep laundering them as you earn them and the total adds up across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Clothes, weapons, vehicle mods and property purchases all count — normal spending across a full playthrough gets most of the way there.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties — $160,000 in total. Garages also store your vehicle collection, so buy them as you can afford them rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles count — register the cars you drive regularly and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.guide: Story trophy — it unlocks when you finish the final mission of Chapter 5. Nothing to prepare; just play the story to the end. After the credits you keep the open world for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission. It unlocks in the first minutes of the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 1. Remember to meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends: it is the one spot for Positive Mental Attitude that may not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 2. Nothing to prepare; it unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Tits Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 3. Nothing to prepare; it unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 4. Nothing to prepare; it unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Breakfast Run mission. It unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete The Cartel Heist mission. It unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Child's Play mission. It unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Headliners mission. It unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the VCIA Takedown mission. It unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. It unlocks as the story advances.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Finish Andy's Stranger mission strand — his final mission is Puff Puff Pass. Strands open as you explore Leonida; follow Andy's strand to its end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's Stranger mission strand to its final mission. Strands open as you explore; follow Kenton's strand to its end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's Stranger mission strand to its final mission. Follow his strand to its end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Stranger mission strand to its final mission. Follow his strand to its end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's Stranger mission strand to its final mission. Follow his strand to its end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his Stranger strand. Bret's quests are also required in full for 100% completion, so his strand is worth finishing early.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA (the airport).
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — get airborne from VCIA outside of a scheduled flight. Any aircraft works; the trophy is about leaving on your own terms.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.description: A secret involving a Rhino tank.
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — a secret involving a Rhino tank. Players are still pinning down the exact trigger, so this guide will not invent one: watch for a Rhino tank encounter in free roam and experiment from there.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive through the showroom glass and out the other side. Any showroom works; pick a fast car and a straight line.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow through at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley. Visit the alley and play through what it offers — the trophy is tied to following through on the activity there.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description hints at a partnership: players report it is about maxing out strength with both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters' strength — gyms and physical activities raise it — until both are maxed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.description: Choices made, for better or worse.
trophies.guide: The description hints at choices adding up: players report it tracks 500 Criminal Profile actions. Keep making criminal-profile choices across your playthrough and the total builds steadily.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by players, so this guide will not invent one — it reads as a trophy for something that fails once, then lands the second time.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description is a mystery by design — 'What just happened?' Players have not yet confirmed a single trigger, so this guide will not invent one: it is an odd, out-of-the-way moment somewhere in Leonida, and the community is still hunting it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — strike a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed by players, so treat the description itself as the instruction.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
